axes_note: both axes are lower-is-better. The map axis is the SYMMETRIC DIFFERENCE and never type I alone -- §9.4: type I read alone ranks silence first, because an arm certifying the empty set scores exactly 0
excluded_note: above-ceiling and INFEASIBLE rows are excluded from the map and regret analyses: §4.5 makes that a property of the threshold, never a method failure. KF-9 still counts them
